chain.name: Shadow of the Mire
chain.description: Three linked jobs out of Mirefoot Harbour.

quests.name: The Sunken Bell
quests.summary: The harbour bell has not rung for nine days.
quests.description: Harbourmaster Vex wants the bell recovered from the silt before the tide festival. He is offering good coin and asking no questions.

milestones.text: Find the bell in the silt channel
Raise it without breaking the yoke
Notice the rope was cut, not frayed

custom.text: A favour from the Smugglers' Guild

quests.gmNotes: Vex sank the bell himself to cover a smuggling run. If the party raises it intact they will find the cut rope still knotted to the clapper.

quests.name: The Ledger of Ash
quests.summary: Someone is buying up debt in the lower ward.
quests.description: Every debt in the lower ward has changed hands in a fortnight, and nobody will say to whom.
quests.gmNotes: The buyer is the party's own patron, using a factor's name.

quests.name: Low Tide
quests.summary: Everything the mire swallowed comes back at low tide.

milestones.text: Reach the wreck before the tide turns
